## Result

What actual behavior or documentation rule changed? Name the owner and affected consumers.
What replaced route was removed? Explain a new abstraction or remaining duplicate only when one is introduced.

## Checks

Exact commit, commands/targets/features and results. For docs: changed links/anchors and diff check.
State NOT_RUN for unavailable execution; source inspection is not runtime evidence.

## Remaining

Concrete unfinished behavior or next removal, if any. Preserve user data and concurrent unpublished work.
Follow [the working guide](https://github.com/UnknownAlienHuman/eliot-search/blob/main/docs/implementation/WORKING_GUIDE.md); no receipts, fixed quotas or extra forms.
